body.statement: For every \(c>0\) and \(t=c/(1+c)\), the causal penalized-welfare regret satisfies \((1+c)\sqrt n\,\mathscr R_n(c)=G(u_n,E_n)(t)=T_n(t)\). Thus the interior process is an identified causal regret curve, and its values at \(t=0\) and \(t=1\) are defined by the two compactified limits.
body.justification: This identity prevents the Gaussian path from becoming a detached statistical surrogate and pins every interior coordinate to the planner's causal objective.
body.gap: The presolve algebra and Fang--Ridder--Xie fixed-weight criterion motivate the identity, but the full local normalization and endpoint compactification are not a published result.
body.consumer: The simultaneous band can be interpreted directly in penalized-welfare units at every interior temperature selected measurably from the observed sample or the plug-in frontier.
